name: The Ritz-Carlton, Denver
positioning: Downtown Denver luxury hotel (official name The Ritz-Carlton, Denver) near the Denver Convention Center, with an in-lobby steakhouse, a 6,000 sq. ft. spa and a Club Lounge
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Denver base near the Convention Center and the stadiums
Guests who want a steakhouse and a spa on site

facts.text: The hotel is near the Denver Convention Center.
The hotel is located just blocks away from Coors Field, Empower Field and Ball Arena.
ELWAY'S Downtown is an upscale steakhouse in the hotel lobby serving breakfast, lunch and dinner.
ELWAY'S Downtown serves USDA prime steaks butchered in-house.
First Light at Elway's is a morning offering, designed as an extension of Elway's Downtown.
Guest rooms have 400-thread-count Frette linens, robes and five-fixture bathrooms.
The Club Lounge offers five daily culinary presentations and an open bar available throughout the day.
The hotel's spa is 6,000 square feet.
The spa has relaxation lounges, steam rooms and whirlpools.
Condé Nast Traveler describes a lobby with dark woods, flower centerpieces and a glass chandelier.

highlights.text: The Mile High Old Fashioned is a guided Colorado whiskey tasting and hands-on cocktail experience.
The spa's signature treatments include a craft-beer body ritual and an oxygen-infused facial designed for high-altitude dehydration.
The Presidential Suite is on the 14th floor and offers city and mountain views.
The Leo the Lion Safari Adventure for kids ages 1 to 7 features a themed tent and take-home goodies.

considerations.text: Denver International Airport is 26.0 miles from the hotel, and the hotel does not provide airport shuttle service.
Club Lounge access requires an upgraded Club booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack resort-style outdoor space.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: The Ritz-Carlton, Denver
